title: Noncyclic geometric phase in three-level Ramsey interferometry for enhanced metrology
summary: In a standard two-level Ramsey interferometer, the accumulated signal phase is linearly mapped to the readout phase. Here, we introduce three-level Ramsey interferometry, in which projected interference between internal paths reshapes this mapping through a noncyclic geometric phase response. Near a geodesic-closure transition, a small accumulated signal phase produces a sharply amplified readout-phase shift.
